summary: Sets the field at this+0x84 to the constant 191 regardless of the a2 argument. A switch on a2 dispatches through the jump table at 0x0054FD20, and cases 1, 2 and 3 first write intermediate values (127, 63, 0) that are immediately overwritten by 191, so every path converges on the same effective result. Returns a2 unchanged.

operations.description: Switch on a2 with cases 0..3 and a default; dispatch uses the jump table at global 0x0054FD20.
Write the effective value 191 to this[33] (offset this+0x84) on every switch path.
Dead intermediate writes: cases 1, 2 and 3 first write 127, 63 and 0 respectively to this[33], each immediately overwritten by the subsequent write of 191.

unresolved: Meaning of the this+0x84 field and of the a2 selector; the switch's intermediate values are dead code.
Whether the intermediate 127/63/0 writes are compiler artifacts or a stripped optimization the decompiler failed to fold.
Caller context (DirectXMeshVertexBufferParsingAndLoading, D3DTextureResourceCreation, sub_557CE0) suggests mesh/texture creation, but the field purpose is not evidenced here.
